what: The owner's free-text verdict on the two TaoMate dancer arms at 1344x768 and 243 frames: the streaming runtime and the whole-clip render with every attention patch stripped (docs/h3_taomate.md section 7.3).

both do. the streamed clip is good tho, it looks like a distill lora but it doesnt duplicate ppl and no obvious artifacts. just the usual distill stuff

reading: Reasoned, not measured. Both new arms dropped the quantized attention stack, sage and Sol, that the earlier TaoMate renders ran under, so that stack was a large part of the earlier failure. The streaming runtime adds, at least on this scene and seed, no duplicated people and no obvious artifacts. One scene, one seed, and the earlier renders used other prompts.
